question: Which of the following countries won the highest number of Kabaddi World Cups, as of 2022 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• India has won all the Kabaddi World Cups held till 2022, making it the country with the highest number of wins.

• The Indian men's team won the Kabaddi World Cup titles in 2004, 2007, and 2016.

• The Indian women's team has also been dominant, winning the Kabaddi World Cup in 2012 and 2013.

• Kabaddi is a traditional sport in India, and the country has produced many world-class players in this sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Kabaddi:**

• Kabaddi is a contact team sport played between two teams of seven players each.

• **Kabaddi World Cup:**

• The Kabaddi World Cup is an indoor international kabaddi competition conducted by the International Kabaddi Federation (IKF).

• The first Kabaddi World Cup was held in 2004, and subsequent tournaments have been organized to promote the sport globally.

• India has been the most successful nation in the Kabaddi World Cup, showcasing its dominance in the sport.

• Both the men's and women's teams from India have consistently performed well in these tournaments, bringing home multiple titles.
